title: Locations
description: Where customers pick up and return cars

help.title: About locations
help.overview: Locations are the branches where cars are picked up and returned. Each has its own time zone and opening hours, and every pickup or return time is checked against them.

sections.title: On this page
items: Set the IANA time zone (for example Europe/Zurich) so bookings stay correct across daylight-saving changes.
Add closed days for holidays; the website won't offer pickups or returns on them.
A location with bookings can't be deleted; deactivate it instead.
